meta.what: The machine-readable presentation table for the merged direction M, with the lead's rulings R1 to R16 (13 Nov) applied. One case per drawable state of fixtures version 3, plus S32 (case C29), C32 (the D13 fact line) and S13-missing (R6), which have no fixture. A Swift test constructs each case's inputs and asserts form, headline, count, icon, and every row's kind, strings and action, in order.
meta.written_by: brainbar-ui-lead-w35 (Claude Opus 5.5, high), 2026-11-13; rulings R1 to R16 applied the same day

rule.form: R1: needs (A1's rows as built) if and only if at least one active row, after escalation and merging (truth table Part 2 steps 1-2), is Needs you. Everything else is calm (A2's menu as built): all fine, something being handled, and Can't tell with nothing for him to do.
rule.count: the number of Needs-you rows after merging (Part 2 step 4). Behind, Can't tell, Fine with a fact (including the D13 transcript fact line) and Fine never count.
rule.icon: marked (A1's brain filled red with the "!") exactly when the form is needs (R1), which is exactly when count >= 1. Otherwise resting: the switch-controlled glyph (today's charts by default, A1's brain ready); this table does not choose it.
rule.headline: truth table Part 2 step 8, first match wins; each form draws it in its own style.
rule.bottom: R4: one bottom block for both forms, A2's as built: a separator, Settings… ⌘, and Quit BrainBar ⌘Q with no separator between them; Option turns Quit BrainBar into Restart BrainBar. Diagnostics is not a first-level item.
rule.words: each form keeps its own build's strings (MERGED-DIRECTION lead's ruling 2). Where the build has none, the lead's ruled wording is used and marked tested: false; where neither exists, text is null.

row_kinds.headline: the headline (with data_count and the form's disc or sign)
row_kinds.headline_detail: calm form: the line under the headline
row_kinds.needs_you: needs form: one block per Needs-you row: title, optional detail, two hand-off lines on a hand-off row, then one blue action button
row_kinds.status_line: one secondary line per Behind or Can't-tell row that is not folded into the headline
row_kinds.fact_line: a Fine-with-a-fact line (only the D13 transcript line here)
row_kinds.everything_else: the one line that stands for the Fine rows it covers
row_kinds.standard_item: Settings… and Quit BrainBar (with its Option alternate)

conventions.divider_before: needs form: a hairline between consecutive Needs-you blocks (mocks/A1/index.html:72)
conventions.apostrophes: R2: every on-screen string uses the typographic apostrophe ’, in both forms. Where a string has one, text_straight gives the same string with the straight apostrophe, as the fixtures, the truth table and A2's copy table write it. Compare text byte for byte.
conventions.source: every build string names its build and the line of that build's COPY-TABLE.md. A2 draws fixture strings verbatim and its table leaves those out by its own rule, so they carry line: null, drawn_by (index.html line) and the fixture field. A2 strings shown with ’ in place of ' are still A2's (R2). A string with tested: false carries ruled: <section>.
conventions.inputs: named as the truth table and the fixtures name them. Any of the 11 checks not given otherwise is green. Every check carries blind: false and unknown_ticks: 0 (seam PR-1 fields) and no recovering unless stated. Times are local (UTC+2) with offset; ageS in seconds. note_for_test explains a value and is not an input.
conventions.not_in_this_table: the window, notifications, Diagnostics and second levels (R5: not decided here).
